commentary.career-cleanup.2: Nobody expected the {career} to take every KO.
commentary.clutch.1: {name} held on with a sliver of health to win it for {winner}.
commentary.clutch.2: Down to the wire — {name} clutches it for {winner}.
commentary.clutch.3: {name} refused to go down. {winner} wins by a thread.
commentary.coward-survivor.1: {name} hid for most of the fight and still won.
commentary.coward-survivor.2: {name}'s strategy: stay out of it. It worked.
commentary.explosion.1: A {prop} exploded. {name} may have been involved.
commentary.explosion.2: BOOM. A {prop} went off right next to {name}.
commentary.explosion.3: The {prop} went up. Nobody is surprised except {name}.
commentary.first-blood.2: First KO of the match: {killer} over {victim}.
commentary.friendly-fire-ko.1: {killer} has knocked out their own teammate {victim}. Awkward.
commentary.friendly-fire-ko.2: {victim} was betrayed by {killer}. HR has been notified.
commentary.friendly-fire-ko.3: Friendly fire! {killer} takes out {victim}, who was on their side.
commentary.healed-enemy.1: {name} the {career} healed an opponent. Professional ethics or confusion?
commentary.healed-enemy.2: {name} patched up {victim} — who is on the other team.
commentary.ironic-ko.1: {victim} the {victimCareer} was taken out by {cause}. Professional embarrassment is total.
commentary.ironic-ko.2: A {victimCareer} defeated by {cause}. You couldn't write this.
commentary.ironic-ko.3: {victim} will not be putting "{cause}" on their CV.
commentary.long-battle.2: A war of attrition in the {arena}.
commentary.machine-hit.1: {name} was run over by the {prop}. Nobody saw the warning sign.
commentary.mass-status.2: At one point, {count} fighters were {status}. Chaos.
commentary.mass-status.3: An epidemic: {count} fighters {status} at the same time.
commentary.panic.1: {name} completely lost their nerve and ran for it.
commentary.panic.3: {name} has decided this is not in their job description.
commentary.rake-hit.1: {name} stepped on a rake. It will never not be funny.
commentary.referee-down.1: The referee has lost control. Literally: {killer} just knocked them out.
commentary.referee-down.2: Referee down! {killer} is going to have some explaining to do.
commentary.referee-down.3: Nobody is officiating this anymore thanks to {killer}.
commentary.ride-hit.2: {victim} has been run over by {name} on a {prop}.
commentary.ride-hit.3: Health and safety would like a word with {name} about that {prop}.
commentary.rival-defeated.2: The grudge match is settled: {killer} over {victim}.
commentary.upset.1: Upset! {winner} beat a team rated {count} points higher.
commentary.yellow-card.1: {name} has been shown a yellow card and a very long lecture.
commentary.yellow-card.2: The referee is not impressed with {name}.
commentary.yellow-card.3: {name} gets a stern talking-to from the referee.

career.chief-surgeon.desc: Head of surgery, head of the golf club, head of the queue. Has never lost a patient, only misplaced several.

ability.old-money.desc: Cannot be embarrassed or lectured. Has been told off by no one, ever.
ability.priceless-exhibit.name: Priceless Artefact
ability.priceless-exhibit.desc: Throws a priceless artefact. The insurance will cover it.

ability.frequent-flyer.desc: Runs on cabin coffee: starts every fight caffeinated and can't get cold.

ability.brace-brace-brace.desc: The crash position, for the whole team: armoured and steadied.

career.airline-captain.desc: Twenty thousand flying hours, forty thousand anecdotes. Will tell you all of them.

ability.star-billing.desc: Top of the bill: starts every fight inspired and cannot be embarrassed.
